import os
import customtkinter as ctk
from PIL import Image
from src.managers.settings_manager import SettingsManager
from src.managers.project_manager import Project
from src.gui.components.project_card import ProjectCard
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox

class ModernDashboard(ctk.CTk):
    def __init__(self, on_project_selected):
        super().__init__()
        self.on_project_selected = on_project_selected
        self.settings = SettingsManager()
        
        # Window Config
        self.title("NeuroLoop Studio")
        self.geometry("900x600")
        self.minsize(800, 500)
        
        # Layout: Grid 1x2 (Sidebar, Main)
        self.grid_columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
        
        self._setup_sidebar()
        self._setup_main_area()
        
        self.load_projects()

    def _setup_sidebar(self):
        self.sidebar = ctk.CTkFrame(self, width=200, corner_radius=0)
        self.sidebar.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        self.sidebar.grid_rowconfigure(4, weight=1) # Spacer

        # Logo / Title
        self.lbl_logo = ctk.CTkLabel(self.sidebar, text="NeuroLoop", font=("Roboto", 24, "bold"))
        self.lbl_logo.grid(row=0, column=0, padx=20, pady=(20, 10))
        
        # New Project Button
        self.btn_new = ctk.CTkButton(self.sidebar, text="+ New Project", command=self.create_new_project)
        self.btn_new.grid(row=1, column=0, padx=20, pady=10)
        
        # Filters (Vision, Audio, Video) - Future impl
        self.lbl_filter = ctk.CTkLabel(self.sidebar, text="FILTER BY:", font=("Roboto", 12), text_color="gray")
        self.lbl_filter.grid(row=2, column=0, padx=20, pady=(20,0), sticky="w")
        
        # Settings at bottom
        self.btn_settings = ctk.CTkButton(self.sidebar, text="Settings", fg_color="transparent", border_width=1, text_color=("gray10", "gray90"), command=self.open_settings)
        self.btn_settings.grid(row=5, column=0, padx=20, pady=20, sticky="s")

    def _setup_main_area(self):
        self.main_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self, corner_radius=0, fg_color=("gray95", "gray10"))
        self.main_frame.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="nsew")
        
        # Header
        self.header = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame, height=50, fg_color="transparent")
        self.header.pack(fill="x", padx=30, pady=20)
        
        self.lbl_recent = ctk.CTkLabel(self.header, text="Recent Projects", font=("Roboto", 20))
        self.lbl_recent.pack(side="left")
        
        self.btn_refresh = ctk.CTkButton(self.header, text="↻", width=30, command=self.load_projects)
        self.btn_refresh.pack(side="right")

        # Scrollable Grid for Cards
        self.scroll_frame = ctk.CTkScrollableFrame(self.main_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        self.scroll_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=20, pady=(0, 20))

    def load_projects(self):
        # Clear existing
        for widget in self.scroll_frame.winfo_children():
            widget.destroy()

        # Find Projects (Logic borrowed from old project_manager)
        from src.utils.config import config_manager
        root_dir = config_manager.get("projects_root_dir")
        if not os.path.exists(root_dir):
            os.makedirs(root_dir)

        projects = [d for d in os.listdir(root_dir) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root_dir, d))]
        
        for i, proj_name in enumerate(projects):
            path = os.path.join(root_dir, proj_name)
            # Peek at project.json to get modality
            modality = "vision"
            try:
                import json
                with open(os.path.join(path, "project.json"), 'r') as f:
                    cfg = json.load(f)
                    modality = cfg.get("modality", "vision")
            except:
                pass
            
            card = ProjectCard(self.scroll_frame, proj_name, modality, path, self.launch_project)
            card.pack(fill="x", pady=5)
    
    def launch_project(self, path):
        print(f"Opening project at {path}")
        try:
            proj = Project(path)
            self.destroy() # Close Dashboard
            self.on_project_selected(proj) # Callback to Main logic
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to load project: {e}")

    def create_new_project(self):
        # Using a modal dialog
        dialog = ctk.CTkInputDialog(text="Enter Project Name:", title="New Project")
        name = dialog.get_input()
        if not name: return
        
        # Modality Selection Window (Mini)
        self.mod_win = ctk.CTkToplevel(self)
        self.mod_win.title("Select Type")
        self.mod_win.geometry("300x250")
        self.mod_win.attributes("-topmost", True)
        
        tk_var = ctk.StringVar(value="vision")
        
        ctk.CTkLabel(self.mod_win, text="Choose Modality:", font=("Roboto", 16)).pack(pady=10)
        ctk.CTkRadioButton(self.mod_win, text="Vision (Image)", variable=tk_var, value="vision").pack(pady=5)
        ctk.CTkRadioButton(self.mod_win, text="Audio (Sound)", variable=tk_var, value="audio").pack(pady=5)
        ctk.CTkRadioButton(self.mod_win, text="Video (Time)", variable=tk_var, value="video").pack(pady=5)
        
        def confirm():
            modality = tk_var.get()
            self.mod_win.destroy()
            
            # Ask for data dir
            data_dir = filedialog.askdirectory(title=f"Select source folder for {modality.upper()}")
            if not data_dir: return
            
            from src.utils.config import config_manager
            root_dir = config_manager.get("projects_root_dir")
            path = os.path.join(root_dir, name)
            
            if os.path.exists(path):
                messagebox.showerror("Error", "Project exists.")
                return
                
            proj = Project(path)
            proj.config["modality"] = modality
            if modality == "audio":
                proj.config["audio_dir_source"] = data_dir
            else:
                proj.config["image_dir_source"] = data_dir
            proj.save_config()
            
            self.load_projects()
            
        ctk.CTkButton(self.mod_win, text="Create", command=confirm).pack(pady=20)

    def open_settings(self):
        # Placeholder
        messagebox.showinfo("Settings", "Global Settings coming soon!")

    - Top Bar (Navigation, Stats)

    - Center (Canvas/Waveform)
    - Right Bar (Control/Predictions)

        self.project = project
        self.settings = SettingsManager()
        
        self.title(f"NeuroLoop Studio - {project.project_name}")

        self.center_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self, fg_color="transparent")
        self.center_frame.grid(row=1, column=1, sticky="nsew", padx=10, pady=10)

        # Note: The old GUIs assume they are the Tk root. We might need to adapt them slightly

        try:

import customtkinter as ctk
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import simpledialog, messagebox, colorchooser
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import threading
import random
from src.managers.model_manager import ModelManager
from src.adapters.yolo_adapter import YOLOAdapter
from src.adapters.florence_adapter import FlorenceAdapter
from src.adapters.sam2_adapter import SAM2Adapter
from src.training.synthetic_generator import SyntheticGenerator
from src.managers.dataset_explorer import DatasetExplorer
from src.training.active_learner import ActiveLearner
from src.utils.theme import ThemeManager


def migrate_annotations(annotations):
    """Migrates old annotation format to the new structured format if necessary."""
    migrated = False
    for filename, anns in annotations.items():
        if not isinstance(anns, dict) or "objects" not in anns:
            migrated = True
            # This is the old format (a simple list of bbox dicts)
            new_anns = {"objects": [], "image_tags": []}
            for ann in anns:
                new_anns["objects"].append({
                    "type": "bbox",
                    "label": ann.get("label"),
                    "points": [ann.get("x1"), ann.get("y1"), ann.get("x2"), ann.get("y2")]
                })
            annotations[filename] = new_anns
    if migrated:
        print("Migrated old annotation format to new structured format.")
    return annotations


class VisionGUI(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(self, master, project):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.project = project
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()
        
        # Initialize Vision Adapters
        self.adapters = {
            "yolo": YOLOAdapter(project),
            "florence": FlorenceAdapter(project),
            "sam2": SAM2Adapter(project),
        }
        # Default active adapter
        self.active_adapter = self.adapters["yolo"]
        self.synthetic_generator = SyntheticGenerator(project)
        self.active_learner = ActiveLearner(project, self.active_adapter)

        # self.master is set by super().__init__
        # self.master.title removed as we are a frame now

        self.data_dir = self.project.image_dir_source
        self.supported_extensions = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".bmp", ".webp")
            
        self.data_ids = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.data_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        self.image_ids = self.data_ids 
        
        # Load session state
        self.index = self.project.session.get("last_image_index", 0)
        self.user_annotations = migrate_annotations(self.project.session.get("annotations", {}))

        # Reinforcement / Correction Tracking
        self.corrections_since_retrain = self.project.session.get("corrections_count", 0)
        self.retrain_buffer = 20  # Can be moved to project config

        self.model_predictions = {}
        
        # UI State
        self.active_tool = "bbox" 
        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.current_shape, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.current_polygon_points = []
        self.scale = 1.0
        self.orig_img = None
        self.tkimg = None

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        # self._setup_menu() # Menu moved to Top Bar of Studio potentially, or kept here but tricky
        
        # self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing) # Handled by Studio

        if self.data_ids:
            self.show_current_data()

    def on_closing(self):
        """Handle window close event."""
        self.save_session()
        # self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        """Saves annotations and current image index to the project's session file."""
        print(f"Saving session for project {self.project.project_name}...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.index, self.corrections_since_retrain)
        self.save_label_list()
        print("Session saved.")
    
    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas for image
        self.canvas_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame)
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.canvas_frame, cursor="cross", bg="#1e1e1e", highlightthickness=0) # Dark bg manually
        self.hbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.canvas.xview)
        self.vbar = tk.Scrollbar(self.canvas_frame, orient=tk.VERTICAL, command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.canvas.config(xscrollcommand=self.hbar.set, yscrollcommand=self.vbar.set)
        self.hbar.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)
        self.vbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.canvas.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Right-hand control panel - NOW INTEGRATED OR SEPARATE?
        # For this refactor, let's keep the internal controls but maybe style them
        self.control_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame, width=250)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        self._setup_tools_panel()
        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_annotation_panel()
        self._setup_button_panel()

        # Bindings
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_button_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_move_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_button_release)
        self.canvas.bind("<Double-Button-1>", self.on_double_click)
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-3>", self.on_right_click)
        # self.master.bind("<Right>", self.next_image) # Binding to root needs care in nested frame
        # self.master.bind("<Left>", self.prev_image)
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self.on_zoom)

        self.stats_label = ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="", anchor="w")
        self.stats_label.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.BOTTOM, padx=10)

    def _setup_tools_panel(self):
        # Using ctk widgets
        tools_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        tools_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkLabel(tools_frame, text="Tools").pack()
        
        self.tool_var = tk.StringVar(value=self.active_tool)
        
        ctk.CTkRadioButton(tools_frame, text="Bounding Box", variable=self.tool_var, value="bbox", command=self.change_tool).pack(anchor="w", padx=5)
        ctk.CTkRadioButton(tools_frame, text="Polygon", variable=self.tool_var, value="polygon", command=self.change_tool).pack(anchor="w", padx=5)
        
    def change_tool(self):
        self.active_tool = self.tool_var.get()
        # Reset any in-progress drawings
        self.current_polygon_points = []
        self.canvas.delete("in_progress_polygon")
        if self.current_shape:
            self.canvas.delete(self.current_shape)
            self.current_shape = None
        print(f"Switched to {self.active_tool} tool.")

    def _setup_model_panel(self):
        model_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        model_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkLabel(model_frame, text="Model Control").pack()
        
        self.active_model_name = tk.StringVar(value="yolov8n.pt")
        model_names = self.model_manager.get_model_names()
        
        self.model_dropdown = ctk.CTkOptionMenu(model_frame, variable=self.active_model_name, values=model_names)
        self.model_dropdown.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=5, pady=5)

        ctk.CTkButton(model_frame, text="Predict", command=self.predict_current_image).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

        ctk.CTkLabel(anno_frame, text="Object Labels").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, bg="#404040", fg="white", borderwidth=0)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=5)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()
        
        label_entry_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(anno_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        label_entry_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        self.label_entry = ctk.CTkEntry(label_entry_frame)
        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.LEFT, expand=True, padx=(5,0))

def migrate_annotations(annotations):
    """Migrates old annotation format to the new structured format if necessary."""
    migrated = False
    for filename, anns in annotations.items():
        if not isinstance(anns, dict) or "objects" not in anns:
            migrated = True
            # This is the old format (a simple list of bbox dicts)
            new_anns = {"objects": [], "image_tags": []}
            for ann in anns:
                new_anns["objects"].append({
                    "type": "bbox",
                    "label": ann.get("label"),
                    "points": [ann.get("x1"), ann.get("y1"), ann.get("x2"), ann.get("y2")]
                })
            annotations[filename] = new_anns
    if migrated:
        print("Migrated old annotation format to new structured format.")
    return annotations

        self.tag_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.tag_listbox.bind("<Button-3>", self.on_tag_right_click)

    def apply_image_tag(self):
        if not self.selected_label:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Select a label from the 'Object Labels' list first.")
            return
        
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        
        current_tags = self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"]
        if self.selected_label not in current_tags:
            current_tags.append(self.selected_label)
            self.update_tag_listbox()
            self.update_stats()

    def on_tag_right_click(self, event):
        try:
            selected_index = self.tag_listbox.nearest(event.y)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_clear(0, tk.END)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_set(selected_index)
            selected_tag = self.tag_listbox.get(selected_index)
            
            if messagebox.askyesno("Delete Tag", f"Delete the image tag '{selected_tag}'?"):
                filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
                self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"].remove(selected_tag)
                self.update_tag_listbox()
                self.update_stats()
        except tk.TclError:
            # Click was not on an item
            pass
            
    def update_tag_listbox(self):
        self.tag_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        current_tags = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", [])
        for tag in sorted(current_tags):
            self.tag_listbox.insert(tk.END, tag)

        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Save Session", command=self.save_session).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10,0))


    def run(self):
        self.master.mainloop()

        self.index = self.project.session.get("last_image_index", 0) # Key remains 'last_image_index' for consistency
        self.user_annotations = self.project.session.get("annotations", {})

        # Reinforcement / Correction Tracking
        self.corrections_since_retrain = self.project.session.get("corrections_count", 0)
        self.retrain_buffer = 20

        self.model_predictions = {}
        
        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()
        self.selected_label = None

        self._setup_ui()
        # self._setup_menu() # Menu handling deferred to Studio

        if self.data_ids:
            self.show_current_data()

    def on_closing(self):
        self.save_session()
        # self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        print(f"Saving session for project {self.project.project_name}...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.index, self.corrections_since_retrain)
        self.save_label_list()
        print("Session saved.")

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas for Waveform
        self.canvas_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame, fg_color="black")
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        
        # Placeholder for matplotlib canvas
        self.figure_canvas = None 

        # Right-hand control panel
        self.control_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame, width=250)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_annotation_panel()
        self._setup_button_panel()
        
        self.stats_label = ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="", anchor="w")
        self.stats_label.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.BOTTOM, padx=10)
        
        # Global bindings tricky in frame, might need to bind to master or focus
        # self.master.bind("<Right>", self.next_data) 
        # self.master.bind("<Left>", self.prev_data)

    def _setup_model_panel(self):
        model_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        model_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkLabel(model_frame, text="Model Control").pack()
        
        ctk.CTkButton(model_frame, text="Detect Events (CLAP)", command=self.predict_current_audio).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(model_frame, text="Transcribe (Whisper)", command=self.transcribe_current_audio).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

        ctk.CTkLabel(anno_frame, text="Event Labels").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, bg="#404040", fg="white", borderwidth=0)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=5)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()
        
        label_entry_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(anno_frame, fg_color="transparent")
        label_entry_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        self.label_entry = ctk.CTkEntry(label_entry_frame)
        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.LEFT, expand=True, padx=(5,0))
        ctk.CTkButton(label_entry_frame, text="+", width=30, command=self.add_label).pack(side=tk.RIGHT, padx=5)

    def _setup_button_panel(self):
        btn_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        btn_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(btn_frame, text="Prev", command=self.prev_data).pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True, padx=2)
        ctk.CTkButton(btn_frame, text="Next", command=self.next_data).pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.X, expand=True, padx=2)
        ctk.CTkButton(btn_frame, text="Save", fg_color="green", command=self.save_session).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

    def show_current_data(self):
        if not self.data_ids: return

        filename = self.data_ids[self.index]
        data_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, filename)
        
        # self.master.title removed
        
        if AUDIO_LIBS_AVAILABLE:
            self.plot_waveform(data_path)
        else:
            for widget in self.canvas_frame.winfo_children(): widget.destroy()
            tk.Label(self.canvas_frame, text=f"Playing: {filename}\n(Visualization libs missing)", fg="white", bg="black").pack(expand=True)

        self.update_stats()

    def plot_waveform(self, audio_path):
        for widget in self.canvas_frame.winfo_children():
            widget.destroy()

        try:
            y, sr = librosa.load(audio_path, sr=None)
            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5), dpi=100)
            librosa.display.waveshow(y, sr=sr, ax=ax, color='cyan')
            ax.set_title(f"Waveform: {os.path.basename(audio_path)}")
            ax.set_xlabel("Time (s)")
            ax.set_ylabel("Amplitude")
            ax.set_facecolor('black')
            fig.patch.set_facecolor('#1e1e1e') # Match dark theme
            ax.tick_params(colors='white')
            ax.xaxis.label.set_color('white')
            ax.yaxis.label.set_color('white')
            ax.title.set_color('white')
            
            ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
            ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
            ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('white')
            ax.spines['left'].set_color('white')

            self.figure_canvas = FigureCanvasTkAgg(fig, master=self.canvas_frame)
            self.figure_canvas.draw()
            self.figure_canvas.get_tk_widget().pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
            plt.close(fig)

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error plotting waveform: {e}")

    # --- Logic ---
    def predict_current_audio(self):
        if not self.data_ids: return
        filename = self.data_ids[self.index]
        data_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, filename)
        
        self.update_stats("Running CLAP inference...")
        self.update() # ctk update
        
        # Stub for CLAP prediction
        try:
            self.active_adapter.load()
            # Pass classes to prompt CLAP
            preds = self.active_adapter.predict(data_path, classes=self.label_list)
            
            # Save predictions
            self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": []})
            for p in preds:
                 self.user_annotations[filename]["objects"].append(p)
                 
            self.increment_correction_counter()
            messagebox.showinfo("Prediction", f"Found {len(preds)} events.")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))
        
        self.update_stats()

    def transcribe_current_audio(self):
        if not self.data_ids: return
        filename = self.data_ids[self.index]
        data_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, filename)
        
        self.update_stats("Running Whisper transcription...")
        self.update()
        
        try:
            preds = self.active_adapter.transcribe(data_path)
            if not preds:
                messagebox.showinfo("Whisper", "No speech detected.")
                return

            self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": []})
            for p in preds:
                 p["type"] = "transcription" 
                 self.user_annotations[filename]["objects"].append(p)
                 
            self.increment_correction_counter()
            messagebox.showinfo("Transcription", f"Generated {len(preds)} segments.")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))
        
        self.update_stats()

    def increment_correction_counter(self):
        self.corrections_since_retrain += 1
        if self.corrections_since_retrain >= self.retrain_buffer:
            if messagebox.askyesno("Reinforcement Training", "Buffer full. Start background audio training?"):
                 self.trigger_retrain()

    def trigger_retrain(self):
        self.save_session()
        self.update_stats("Training Audio Model...")
        self.update()
        
        try:
            # Trains the custom classifier (MLP on CLAP embeddings)
            model_path = self.active_adapter.retrain(self.project)
            if model_path:
                messagebox.showinfo("Reinforcement", f"Custom Audio Classifier trained and saved!\nLocation: {model_path}")
                # Reload adapter to use the new classifier immediately
                self.active_adapter.load_custom_classifier()
            else:
                messagebox.showwarning("Reinforcement", "Not enough data to train. Annotate more audio segments.")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Reinforcement failed: {e}")
            print(e)
            
        self.corrections_since_retrain = 0
        self.save_session()

    def update_stats(self, status=None):
        if status:
            self.stats_label.configure(text=status)
        else:
            filename = self.data_ids[self.index]
            count = len(self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", []))
            self.stats_label.configure(text=f"Events: {count} | Active Label: {self.selected_label}")

    # --- Labels & Nav ---
    def load_label_list(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.label_file):
            with open(self.label_file, "r") as f:
                try:
                    data = json.load(f)
                    return data.get("labels", []), data.get("colors", {})
                except:
                    return [], {}
        return [], {}

    def save_label_list(self):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.label_file), exist_ok=True)
        with open(self.label_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"labels": self.label_list, "colors": self.label_colors}, f)

    def populate_label_listbox(self):
        self.label_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        for label in self.label_list: self.label_listbox.insert(tk.END, label)

    def add_label(self):
        label = self.label_entry.get().strip()
        if label and label not in self.label_list:
            self.label_list.append(label)
            self.label_colors[label] = "red"
            self.populate_label_listbox()
            self.label_entry.delete(0, tk.END)

    def on_label_select(self, event):
        sel = self.label_listbox.curselection()
        if sel:
            self.selected_label = self.label_list[sel[0]]

    def next_data(self, event=None):
        if self.index < len(self.data_ids) - 1:
            self.save_session()
            self.index += 1
            self.show_current_data()

    def prev_data(self, event=None):
        if self.index > 0:
            self.save_session()
            self.index -= 1
            self.show_current_data()

    def generate_synthetic_data(self):
        if not self.data_ids: return
        filename = self.data_ids[self.index]
        audio_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, filename)
        
        current_anns = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        count = simpledialog.askinteger("Synthetic Audio", f"Generate how many variants for {filename}?", initialvalue=3, minvalue=1, maxvalue=10)
        if not count: return
        
        self.update_stats(f"Generating {count} synthetic variants...")
        self.update()
        
        new_files, new_annotations = self.audio_augmentor.generate_variants(audio_path, current_anns, count=count)
        
        if new_files:
            self.user_annotations.update(new_annotations)
            self.save_session()
            self.data_ids = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(self.data_dir) if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)])
            messagebox.showinfo("Success", f"Generated {len(new_files)} synthetic audio files.")
            self.update_stats(f"Generated {len(new_files)} variants.")
        else:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Failed to generate synthetic data.")

import os
import json
import tkinter as tk
import customtkinter as ctk
from tkinter import simpledialog, messagebox, colorchooser
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import cv2
import threading
import time
from src.managers.model_manager import ModelManager
from src.adapters.yolo_adapter import YOLOAdapter
from src.adapters.sam2_adapter import SAM2Adapter
from src.managers.dataset_explorer import DatasetExplorer
from src.utils.theme import ThemeManager

class VideoGUI(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(self, master, project):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.project = project
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()
        
        # Initialize Adapters
        self.adapters = {
            "yolo": YOLOAdapter(project),
            "sam2": SAM2Adapter(project)
        }
        self.active_adapter = self.adapters["yolo"]

        # self.master set by super

        # Video Data Setup
        # For video projects, we expect the image_dir to contain video files
        self.data_dir = self.project.image_dir_source # Reusing this config key
        self.supported_extensions = (".mp4", ".avi", ".mov", ".mkv")
            
        self.video_files = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.data_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        
        if not self.video_files:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "No video files found in the project directory.")
            # self.master.destroy() # Don't destroy shell
            return

        self.current_video_index = 0
        self.cap = None
        self.total_frames = 0
        self.current_frame_idx = 0
        self.fps = 30
        self.is_playing = False
        
        # Load session state
        # structure: annotations[video_filename][frame_idx] = { objects: ... }
        self.user_annotations = self.project.session.get("annotations", {})
        
        # UI State
        self.active_tool = "bbox" 
        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.current_shape, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.scale = 1.0
        self.tkimg = None
        self.frame_image = None # PIL Image of current frame

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        # self._setup_menu()
        
        # Apply Theme
        # self.theme = ThemeManager.apply_theme(self.master, "dark")
        # self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing)

        self.load_video(self.video_files[0])

    def on_closing(self):
        if self.cap: self.cap.release()
        self.save_session()
        # self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        print(f"Saving session...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.current_video_index, 0)
        self.save_label_list()

    def load_video(self, filename):
        if self.cap: self.cap.release()
        path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, filename)
        self.cap = cv2.VideoCapture(path)
        self.total_frames = int(self.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))
        self.fps = self.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 30
        self.current_frame_idx = 0
        
        # self.master.title removed
        self.timeline.configure(to=self.total_frames - 1)
        self.seek_frame(0)

    def seek_frame(self, frame_idx):
        if not self.cap: return
        self.cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_idx)
        ret, frame = self.cap.read()
        if ret:
            self.current_frame_idx = frame_idx
            # Convert BGR to RGB
            cv2_im = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
            self.frame_image = Image.fromarray(cv2_im)
            self.show_scaled_image()
            self.timeline.set(frame_idx)
            self.update_stats()
        else:
            print("Error reading frame.")

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas
        self.canvas_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame)
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.canvas_frame, cursor="cross", bg="#333", highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Timeline Slider
        self.timeline_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.timeline_frame.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=5)
        self.timeline = ctk.CTkSlider(self.timeline_frame, from_=0, to=100, orientation=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.on_slider_move)
        self.timeline.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=5)
        
        # Controls
        self.controls_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.controls_frame.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text="<<", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(-30)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text="<", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(-1)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        self.play_btn = ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text="Play", width=60, command=self.toggle_play)
        self.play_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=20)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text=">", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(1)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text=">>", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(30)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        # Right Panel
        self.control_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame, width=250)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self._setup_tools_panel()
        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_annotation_panel()

        # Canvas Bindings
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_button_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_move_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_button_release)
        # self.master.bind("<space>", self.toggle_play)

        self.stats_label = ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="", anchor="w")
        self.stats_label.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)

    def _setup_tools_panel(self):
        tools_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        tools_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkLabel(tools_frame, text="Tools").pack()
        self.tool_var = tk.StringVar(value="bbox")
        ctk.CTkRadioButton(tools_frame, text="Bounding Box", variable=self.tool_var, value="bbox", command=lambda: setattr(self, 'active_tool', 'bbox')).pack(anchor="w", padx=5)

    def _setup_model_panel(self):
        model_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        model_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkLabel(model_frame, text="Model Control").pack()
        ctk.CTkButton(model_frame, text="Track Object (SAM 2)", command=self.track_object).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

    def track_object(self):
        # 1. Get current video and frame
        vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
        video_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, vid_key)
        
        # 2. Get the LAST created bbox in this frame as the prompt
        frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
        anns = self.user_annotations.get(vid_key, {}).get(frame_key, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        if not anns:
            messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Draw a bounding box around the object to track first.")
            return
            
        # Assume last one is the prompt
        prompt_ann = anns[-1]
        if prompt_ann["type"] != "bbox":
             messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Please use a bounding box as prompt.")
             return
             
        box = prompt_ann["points"] # [x1, y1, x2, y2] scaled? 
        # Points are stored scaled if self.scale was used? 
        # Let's check: "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), ...]
        # Yes, they are in original image coords. Perfect.
        
        label = prompt_ann["label"]
        
        self.stats_label.configure(text="SAM 2: Extracting frames & Tracking... (This may take a while)")
        self.update()
        
        # 3. Call Adapter
        results = self.adapters["sam2"].track_object(video_path, self.current_frame_idx, box, label)
        
        if not results:
            messagebox.showerror("SAM 2", "Tracking failed or returned no results.")
            self.update_stats()
            return
            
        # 4. Merge results
        count = 0
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(vid_key, {})
        for frame_idx, ann in results.items():
            f_key = str(frame_idx)
            self.user_annotations[vid_key].setdefault(f_key, {"objects": []})
            self.user_annotations[vid_key][f_key]["objects"].append(ann)
            count += 1
            
        self.update_stats()
        messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", f"Tracked object across {count} frames.")
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

        ctk.CTkLabel(anno_frame, text="Labels").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, bg="#404040", fg="white", borderwidth=0)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=5)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()
        
        self.label_entry = ctk.CTkEntry(anno_frame)
        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(anno_frame, text="Add Label", command=self.add_label).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

    # --- Video Logic ---
    def on_slider_move(self, val):
        # Only seek if not playing to avoid conflict, or simple debounce
        if not self.is_playing:
            self.seek_frame(int(val))

    def seek_relative(self, delta):
        new_idx = max(0, min(self.total_frames-1, self.current_frame_idx + delta))
        self.seek_frame(new_idx)

    def toggle_play(self, event=None):
        self.is_playing = not self.is_playing
        self.play_btn.configure(text="Pause" if self.is_playing else "Play")
        if self.is_playing:
            threading.Thread(target=self.play_loop, daemon=True).start()

    def play_loop(self):
        while self.is_playing and self.current_frame_idx < self.total_frames - 1:
            start_time = time.time()
            self.current_frame_idx += 1
            
            # Update UI in main thread
            # We can't call canvas update from thread easily without slight risk, 
            # but reading frame is IO bound. 
            # Ideally use master.after.
            self.after_idle(lambda: self.timeline.set(self.current_frame_idx))
            self.after_idle(lambda idx=self.current_frame_idx: self.seek_frame(idx))
            
            elapsed = time.time() - start_time
            delay = max(0.001, (1.0/self.fps) - elapsed)
            time.sleep(delay)
        
        if self.current_frame_idx >= self.total_frames - 1:
            self.is_playing = False
            self.play_btn.configure(text="Play")

    # --- Display & Annotation ---
    def show_scaled_image(self):
        if not self.frame_image: return
        w, h = self.frame_image.size
        # Simple scale to fit if needed, or keep 1.0
        new_size = (int(w * self.scale), int(h * self.scale))
        resized = self.frame_image.resize(new_size, Image.LANCZOS)
        self.tkimg = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, anchor="nw", image=self.tkimg)
        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox(tk.ALL))
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def redraw_annotations(self):
        vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
        frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
        
        # Structure: annotations -> filename -> frame_idx_str -> objects
        # Note: JSON keys are strings
        anns = self.user_annotations.get(vid_key, {}).get(frame_key, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        for ann in anns:
            color = self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "yellow")
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = [p * self.scale for p in ann["points"]]

        self.save_label_list()

        self.fps = self.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 30
        self.current_frame_idx = 0
        
        self.master.title(f"NeuroLoop (Video) - {filename}")
        self.timeline.config(to=self.total_frames - 1)
        self.seek_frame(0)

    def seek_frame(self, frame_idx):
        if not self.cap: return
        self.cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_idx)

        self.control_panel = tk.Frame(self.main_frame, padx=10, pady=10)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)

        self.stats_label.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)

        tools_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        self.tool_var = tk.StringVar(value="bbox")
        tk.Radiobutton(tools_frame, text="Bounding Box", variable=self.tool_var, value="bbox", command=lambda: setattr(self, 'active_tool', 'bbox')).pack(anchor="w")

    def _setup_model_panel(self):
        model_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Model Control", padx=5, pady=5)
        model_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        tk.Button(model_frame, text="Track Object (SAM 2)", command=self.track_object).pack(fill=tk.X)

    def track_object(self):
        # 1. Get current video and frame
        vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
        video_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, vid_key)
        
        # 2. Get the LAST created bbox in this frame as the prompt
        frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
        anns = self.user_annotations.get(vid_key, {}).get(frame_key, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        if not anns:
            messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Draw a bounding box around the object to track first.")
            return
            
        # Assume last one is the prompt
        prompt_ann = anns[-1]
        if prompt_ann["type"] != "bbox":
             messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Please use a bounding box as prompt.")
             return
             
        box = prompt_ann["points"] # [x1, y1, x2, y2] scaled? 
        # Points are stored scaled if self.scale was used? 
        # Let's check: "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), ...]
        # Yes, they are in original image coords. Perfect.
        
        label = prompt_ann["label"]
        
        self.stats_label.config(text="SAM 2: Extracting frames & Tracking... (This may take a while)")
        self.master.update()
        
        # 3. Call Adapter
        results = self.adapters["sam2"].track_object(video_path, self.current_frame_idx, box, label)
        
        if not results:
            messagebox.showerror("SAM 2", "Tracking failed or returned no results.")
            self.update_stats()
            return
            
        # 4. Merge results
        count = 0
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(vid_key, {})
        for frame_idx, ann in results.items():
            f_key = str(frame_idx)
            self.user_annotations[vid_key].setdefault(f_key, {"objects": []})
            self.user_annotations[vid_key][f_key]["objects"].append(ann)
            count += 1
            
        self.update_stats()
        messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", f"Tracked object across {count} frames.")
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Annotations", padx=5, pady=5)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)

        tk.Label(anno_frame, text="Labels:").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, exportselection=False)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()

        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X)
        tk.Button(anno_frame, text="Add Label", command=self.add_label).pack(fill=tk.X)

    # --- Video Logic ---
    def on_slider_move(self, val):
        # Only seek if not playing to avoid conflict, or simple debounce
        if not self.is_playing:
            self.seek_frame(int(val))

    def seek_relative(self, delta):
        new_idx = max(0, min(self.total_frames-1, self.current_frame_idx + delta))
        self.seek_frame(new_idx)

    def toggle_play(self, event=None):
        self.is_playing = not self.is_playing
        self.play_btn.config(text="Pause" if self.is_playing else "Play")
        if self.is_playing:
            threading.Thread(target=self.play_loop, daemon=True).start()

    def play_loop(self):
        while self.is_playing and self.current_frame_idx < self.total_frames - 1:
            start_time = time.time()
            self.current_frame_idx += 1
            
            # Update UI in main thread
            # We can't call canvas update from thread easily without slight risk, 
            # but reading frame is IO bound. 
            # Ideally use master.after.
            self.master.after_idle(lambda: self.timeline.set(self.current_frame_idx))
            self.master.after_idle(lambda idx=self.current_frame_idx: self.seek_frame(idx))
            
            elapsed = time.time() - start_time
            delay = max(0.001, (1.0/self.fps) - elapsed)
            time.sleep(delay)
        
        if self.current_frame_idx >= self.total_frames - 1:
            self.is_playing = False
            self.play_btn.config(text="Play")

    def show_scaled_image(self):
        if not self.frame_image: return

        new_size = (int(w * self.scale), int(h * self.scale))

    def on_closing(self):

    def save_session(self):
        print(f"Saving session...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.current_video_index, 0)

    def load_video(self, filename):
        if self.cap: self.cap.release()
        path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, filename)
        self.cap = cv2.VideoCapture(path)
        self.total_frames = int(self.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))
        self.fps = self.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 30
        self.current_frame_idx = 0
        
        self.master.title(f"NeuroLoop (Video) - {filename}")
        self.timeline.config(to=self.total_frames - 1)
        self.seek_frame(0)

    def seek_frame(self, frame_idx):
        if not self.cap: return
        self.cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_idx)
        ret, frame = self.cap.read()
        if ret:
            self.current_frame_idx = frame_idx
            # Convert BGR to RGB
            cv2_im = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
            self.frame_image = Image.fromarray(cv2_im)
            self.show_scaled_image()
            self.timeline.set(frame_idx)
            self.update_stats()
        else:
            print("Error reading frame.")

    def track_object(self):
        # 1. Get current video and frame
        vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
        video_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, vid_key)
        
        # 2. Get the LAST created bbox in this frame as the prompt
        frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
        anns = self.user_annotations.get(vid_key, {}).get(frame_key, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        if not anns:
            messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Draw a bounding box around the object to track first.")
            return
            
        # Assume last one is the prompt
        prompt_ann = anns[-1]
        if prompt_ann["type"] != "bbox":
             messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Please use a bounding box as prompt.")
             return
             
        box = prompt_ann["points"] # [x1, y1, x2, y2] scaled? 
        # Points are stored scaled if self.scale was used? 
        # Let's check: "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), ...]
        # Yes, they are in original image coords. Perfect.
        
        label = prompt_ann["label"]
        
        self.stats_label.config(text="SAM 2: Extracting frames & Tracking... (This may take a while)")
        self.master.update()
        
        # 3. Call Adapter
        results = self.adapters["sam2"].track_object(video_path, self.current_frame_idx, box, label)
        
        if not results:
            messagebox.showerror("SAM 2", "Tracking failed or returned no results.")
            self.update_stats()
            return
            
        # 4. Merge results
        count = 0
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(vid_key, {})
        for frame_idx, ann in results.items():
            f_key = str(frame_idx)
            self.user_annotations[vid_key].setdefault(f_key, {"objects": []})
            self.user_annotations[vid_key][f_key]["objects"].append(ann)
            count += 1
            
        self.update_stats()
        messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", f"Tracked object across {count} frames.")
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = tk.LabelFrame(self.control_panel, text="Annotations", padx=5, pady=5)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5)

        tk.Label(anno_frame, text="Labels:").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, exportselection=False)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()

        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X)
        tk.Button(anno_frame, text="Add Label", command=self.add_label).pack(fill=tk.X)

    # --- Video Logic ---
    def on_slider_move(self, val):
        # Only seek if not playing to avoid conflict, or simple debounce
        if not self.is_playing:
            self.seek_frame(int(val))

    def seek_relative(self, delta):
        new_idx = max(0, min(self.total_frames-1, self.current_frame_idx + delta))
        self.seek_frame(new_idx)

    def toggle_play(self, event=None):
        self.is_playing = not self.is_playing
        self.play_btn.config(text="Pause" if self.is_playing else "Play")
        if self.is_playing:
            threading.Thread(target=self.play_loop, daemon=True).start()

    def play_loop(self):
        while self.is_playing and self.current_frame_idx < self.total_frames - 1:
            start_time = time.time()
            self.current_frame_idx += 1
            
            # Update UI in main thread
            # We can't call canvas update from thread easily without slight risk, 
            # but reading frame is IO bound. 
            # Ideally use master.after.
            self.master.after_idle(lambda: self.timeline.set(self.current_frame_idx))
            self.master.after_idle(lambda idx=self.current_frame_idx: self.seek_frame(idx))
            
            elapsed = time.time() - start_time
            delay = max(0.001, (1.0/self.fps) - elapsed)
            time.sleep(delay)
        
        if self.current_frame_idx >= self.total_frames - 1:
            self.is_playing = False
            self.play_btn.config(text="Play")

    # --- Display & Annotation ---
    def show_scaled_image(self):
        if not self.frame_image: return
        w, h = self.frame_image.size
        # Simple scale to fit if needed, or keep 1.0
        new_size = (int(w * self.scale), int(h * self.scale))
        resized = self.frame_image.resize(new_size, Image.LANCZOS)
        self.tkimg = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, anchor="nw", image=self.tkimg)
        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox(tk.ALL))
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def redraw_annotations(self):
        vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
        frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
        
        # Structure: annotations -> filename -> frame_idx_str -> objects
        # Note: JSON keys are strings
        anns = self.user_annotations.get(vid_key, {}).get(frame_key, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        for ann in anns:
            color = self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "yellow")
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = [p * self.scale for p in ann["points"]]
                self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, outline=color, width=2, tags="annotation")
                self.canvas.create_text(x1, y1, text=ann["label"], anchor="sw", fill=color, tags="annotation")

    # --- Drawing ---
    def on_button_press(self, event):
        if not self.selected_label: return
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
        self.current_shape = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline="cyan")

    def on_move_press(self, event):
        if self.current_shape:
            cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def on_button_release(self, event):
        if self.current_shape:
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape)
            self.canvas.delete(self.current_shape)
            self.current_shape = None
            
            # Save annotation
            vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
            frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
            
            self.user_annotations.setdefault(vid_key, {})
            self.user_annotations[vid_key].setdefault(frame_key, {"objects": []})
            
            ann = {
                "type": "bbox",
                "label": self.selected_label,
                "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(min(y1, y2) / self.scale), int(max(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(max(y1, y2) / self.scale)]
            }
            self.user_annotations[vid_key][frame_key]["objects"].append(ann)
            self.redraw_annotations()

    # --- Labels ---
    def load_label_list(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.label_file):
            with open(self.label_file, "r") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
                return d.get("labels", []), d.get("colors", {})
        return [], {}

    def save_label_list(self):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.label_file), exist_ok=True)
        with open(self.label_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"labels": self.label_list, "colors": self.label_colors}, f)

    def populate_label_listbox(self):
        self.label_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        for l in self.label_list: self.label_listbox.insert(tk.END, l)

    def add_label(self):
        l = self.label_entry.get().strip()
        if l and l not in self.label_list:
            self.label_list.append(l)
            self.label_colors[l] = "red"
            self.populate_label_listbox()

    def on_label_select(self, event):
        sel = self.label_listbox.curselection()
        if sel: self.selected_label = self.label_list[sel[0]]

    def update_stats(self):
        self.stats_label.config(text=f"Frame: {self.current_frame_idx}/{self.total_frames} | Time: {self.current_frame_idx/self.fps:.2f}s")

import os
import json
import tkinter as tk
import customtkinter as ctk
from tkinter import simpledialog, messagebox, colorchooser
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import cv2
import threading
import time
from src.managers.model_manager import ModelManager
from src.adapters.yolo_adapter import YOLOAdapter
from src.adapters.sam2_adapter import SAM2Adapter
from src.managers.dataset_explorer import DatasetExplorer
from src.utils.theme import ThemeManager

class VideoGUI(ctk.CTkFrame):
    def __init__(self, master, project):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.project = project
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()
        
        # Initialize Adapters
        self.adapters = {
            "yolo": YOLOAdapter(project),
            "sam2": SAM2Adapter(project)
        }
        self.active_adapter = self.adapters["yolo"]

        # self.master set by super

        # Video Data Setup
        # For video projects, we expect the image_dir to contain video files
        self.data_dir = self.project.image_dir_source # Reusing this config key
        self.supported_extensions = (".mp4", ".avi", ".mov", ".mkv")
            
        self.video_files = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.data_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        
        if not self.video_files:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "No video files found in the project directory.")
            # self.master.destroy()
            return

        self.current_video_index = 0
        self.cap = None
        self.total_frames = 0
        self.current_frame_idx = 0
        self.fps = 30
        self.is_playing = False
        
        # Load session state
        # structure: annotations[video_filename][frame_idx] = { objects: ... }
        self.user_annotations = self.project.session.get("annotations", {})
        
        # UI State
        self.active_tool = "bbox" 
        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.current_shape, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.scale = 1.0
        self.tkimg = None
        self.frame_image = None # PIL Image of current frame

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        # self._setup_menu()
        
        # Apply Theme
        # self.theme = ThemeManager.apply_theme(self.master, "dark")
        # self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing)

        self.load_video(self.video_files[0])

    def on_closing(self):
        if self.cap: self.cap.release()
        self.save_session()
        # self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):
        print(f"Saving session...")
        self.project.save_session(self.user_annotations, self.current_video_index, 0)
        self.save_label_list()

    def load_video(self, filename):
        if self.cap: self.cap.release()
        path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, filename)
        self.cap = cv2.VideoCapture(path)
        self.total_frames = int(self.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))
        self.fps = self.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 30
        self.current_frame_idx = 0
        
        # self.master.title removed
        self.timeline.configure(to=self.total_frames - 1)
        self.seek_frame(0)

    def seek_frame(self, frame_idx):
        if not self.cap: return
        self.cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, frame_idx)
        ret, frame = self.cap.read()
        if ret:
            self.current_frame_idx = frame_idx
            # Convert BGR to RGB
            cv2_im = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
            self.frame_image = Image.fromarray(cv2_im)
            self.show_scaled_image()
            self.timeline.set(frame_idx)
            self.update_stats()
        else:
            print("Error reading frame.")

    def _setup_ui(self):
        self.main_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.main_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas
        self.canvas_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame)
        self.canvas_frame.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.canvas_frame, cursor="cross", bg="#333", highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Timeline Slider
        self.timeline_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.timeline_frame.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=5)
        self.timeline = ctk.CTkSlider(self.timeline_frame, from_=0, to=100, orientation=tk.HORIZONTAL, command=self.on_slider_move)
        self.timeline.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=10, pady=5)
        
        # Controls
        self.controls_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self)
        self.controls_frame.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X, pady=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text="<<", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(-30)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text="<", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(-1)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        self.play_btn = ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text="Play", width=60, command=self.toggle_play)
        self.play_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=20)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text=">", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(1)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(self.controls_frame, text=">>", width=40, command=lambda: self.seek_relative(30)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        # Right Panel
        self.control_panel = ctk.CTkFrame(self.main_frame, width=250)
        self.control_panel.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self._setup_tools_panel()
        self._setup_model_panel()
        self._setup_annotation_panel()

        # Canvas Bindings
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_button_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_move_press)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_button_release)
        # self.master.bind("<space>", self.toggle_play)

        self.stats_label = ctk.CTkLabel(self, text="", anchor="w")
        self.stats_label.pack(side=tk.BOTTOM, fill=tk.X)

    def _setup_tools_panel(self):
        tools_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        tools_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkLabel(tools_frame, text="Tools").pack()
        self.tool_var = tk.StringVar(value="bbox")
        ctk.CTkRadioButton(tools_frame, text="Bounding Box", variable=self.tool_var, value="bbox", command=lambda: setattr(self, 'active_tool', 'bbox')).pack(anchor="w", padx=5)

    def _setup_model_panel(self):
        model_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        model_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkLabel(model_frame, text="Model Control").pack()
        ctk.CTkButton(model_frame, text="Track Object (SAM 2)", command=self.track_object).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

    def track_object(self):
        # 1. Get current video and frame
        vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
        video_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, vid_key)
        
        # 2. Get the LAST created bbox in this frame as the prompt
        frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
        anns = self.user_annotations.get(vid_key, {}).get(frame_key, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        if not anns:
            messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Draw a bounding box around the object to track first.")
            return
            
        # Assume last one is the prompt
        prompt_ann = anns[-1]
        if prompt_ann["type"] != "bbox":
             messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", "Please use a bounding box as prompt.")
             return
             
        box = prompt_ann["points"] # [x1, y1, x2, y2] scaled? 
        # Points are stored scaled if self.scale was used? 
        # Let's check: "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), ...]
        # Yes, they are in original image coords. Perfect.
        
        label = prompt_ann["label"]
        
        self.stats_label.configure(text="SAM 2: Extracting frames & Tracking... (This may take a while)")
        self.update()
        
        # 3. Call Adapter
        results = self.adapters["sam2"].track_object(video_path, self.current_frame_idx, box, label)
        
        if not results:
            messagebox.showerror("SAM 2", "Tracking failed or returned no results.")
            self.update_stats()
            return
            
        # 4. Merge results
        count = 0
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(vid_key, {})
        for frame_idx, ann in results.items():
            f_key = str(frame_idx)
            self.user_annotations[vid_key].setdefault(f_key, {"objects": []})
            self.user_annotations[vid_key][f_key]["objects"].append(ann)
            count += 1
            
        self.update_stats()
        messagebox.showinfo("SAM 2", f"Tracked object across {count} frames.")
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def _setup_annotation_panel(self):
        anno_frame = ctk.CTkFrame(self.control_panel)
        anno_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

        ctk.CTkLabel(anno_frame, text="Labels").pack(anchor="w")
        self.label_listbox = tk.Listbox(anno_frame, height=8, bg="#404040", fg="white", borderwidth=0)
        self.label_listbox.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=5)
        self.label_listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_label_select)
        self.populate_label_listbox()
        
        self.label_entry = ctk.CTkEntry(anno_frame)
        self.label_entry.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)
        ctk.CTkButton(anno_frame, text="Add Label", command=self.add_label).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=5, padx=5)

    # --- Video Logic ---
    def on_slider_move(self, val):
        # Only seek if not playing to avoid conflict, or simple debounce
        if not self.is_playing:
            self.seek_frame(int(val))

    def seek_relative(self, delta):
        new_idx = max(0, min(self.total_frames-1, self.current_frame_idx + delta))
        self.seek_frame(new_idx)

    def toggle_play(self, event=None):
        self.is_playing = not self.is_playing
        self.play_btn.configure(text="Pause" if self.is_playing else "Play")
        if self.is_playing:
            threading.Thread(target=self.play_loop, daemon=True).start()

    def play_loop(self):
        while self.is_playing and self.current_frame_idx < self.total_frames - 1:
            start_time = time.time()
            self.current_frame_idx += 1
            
            # Update UI in main thread
            # We can't call canvas update from thread easily without slight risk, 
            # but reading frame is IO bound. 
            # Ideally use master.after.
            self.after_idle(lambda: self.timeline.set(self.current_frame_idx))
            self.after_idle(lambda idx=self.current_frame_idx: self.seek_frame(idx))
            
            elapsed = time.time() - start_time
            delay = max(0.001, (1.0/self.fps) - elapsed)
            time.sleep(delay)
        
        if self.current_frame_idx >= self.total_frames - 1:
            self.is_playing = False
            self.play_btn.configure(text="Play")

    # --- Display & Annotation ---
    def show_scaled_image(self):
        if not self.frame_image: return
        w, h = self.frame_image.size
        # Simple scale to fit if needed, or keep 1.0
        new_size = (int(w * self.scale), int(h * self.scale))
        resized = self.frame_image.resize(new_size, Image.LANCZOS)
        self.tkimg = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized)
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, anchor="nw", image=self.tkimg)
        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox(tk.ALL))
        self.redraw_annotations()

    def redraw_annotations(self):
        vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
        frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
        
        # Structure: annotations -> filename -> frame_idx_str -> objects
        # Note: JSON keys are strings
        anns = self.user_annotations.get(vid_key, {}).get(frame_key, {}).get("objects", [])
        
        for ann in anns:
            color = self.label_colors.get(ann["label"], "yellow")
            if ann["type"] == "bbox":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = [p * self.scale for p in ann["points"]]
                self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, outline=color, width=2, tags="annotation")
                self.canvas.create_text(x1, y1, text=ann["label"], anchor="sw", fill=color, tags="annotation")

    # --- Drawing ---
    def on_button_press(self, event):
        if not self.selected_label: return
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
        self.current_shape = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline="cyan")

    def on_move_press(self, event):
        if self.current_shape:
            cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def on_button_release(self, event):
        if self.current_shape:
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.current_shape)
            self.canvas.delete(self.current_shape)
            self.current_shape = None
            
            # Save annotation
            vid_key = self.video_files[self.current_video_index]
            frame_key = str(self.current_frame_idx)
            
            self.user_annotations.setdefault(vid_key, {})
            self.user_annotations[vid_key].setdefault(frame_key, {"objects": []})
            
            ann = {
                "type": "bbox",
                "label": self.selected_label,
                "points": [int(min(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(min(y1, y2) / self.scale), int(max(x1, x2) / self.scale), int(max(y1, y2) / self.scale)]
            }
            self.user_annotations[vid_key][frame_key]["objects"].append(ann)
            self.redraw_annotations()

    # --- Labels ---
    def load_label_list(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.label_file):
            with open(self.label_file, "r") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
                return d.get("labels", []), d.get("colors", {})
        return [], {}

    def save_label_list(self):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.label_file), exist_ok=True)
        with open(self.label_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"labels": self.label_list, "colors": self.label_colors}, f)

    def populate_label_listbox(self):
        self.label_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        for l in self.label_list: self.label_listbox.insert(tk.END, l)

    def add_label(self):
        l = self.label_entry.get().strip()
        if l and l not in self.label_list:
            self.label_list.append(l)
            self.label_colors[l] = "red"
            self.populate_label_listbox()

    def on_label_select(self, event):
        sel = self.label_listbox.curselection()
        if sel: self.selected_label = self.label_list[sel[0]]

    def update_stats(self):
        self.stats_label.configure(text=f"Frame: {self.current_frame_idx}/{self.total_frames} | Time: {self.current_frame_idx/self.fps:.2f}s")

import os
import json
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import simpledialog, messagebox, colorchooser
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import threading
import random
from src.managers.model_manager import ModelManager
from src.adapters.yolo_adapter import YOLOAdapter
from src.adapters.florence_adapter import FlorenceAdapter
from src.adapters.sam2_adapter import SAM2Adapter
from src.training.synthetic_generator import SyntheticGenerator
from src.managers.dataset_explorer import DatasetExplorer
from src.training.active_learner import ActiveLearner
from src.utils.theme import ThemeManager


def migrate_annotations(annotations):
    """Migrates old annotation format to the new structured format if necessary."""
    migrated = False
    for filename, anns in annotations.items():
        if not isinstance(anns, dict) or "objects" not in anns:
            migrated = True
            # This is the old format (a simple list of bbox dicts)
            new_anns = {"objects": [], "image_tags": []}
            for ann in anns:
                new_anns["objects"].append({
                    "type": "bbox",
                    "label": ann.get("label"),
                    "points": [ann.get("x1"), ann.get("y1"), ann.get("x2"), ann.get("y2")]
                })
            annotations[filename] = new_anns
    if migrated:
        print("Migrated old annotation format to new structured format.")
    return annotations


class VisionGUI:
    def __init__(self, project):
        self.project = project
        self.model_manager = ModelManager()
        
        # Initialize Vision Adapters
        self.adapters = {
            "yolo": YOLOAdapter(project),
            "florence": FlorenceAdapter(project),
            "sam2": SAM2Adapter(project),
        }
        # Default active adapter
        self.active_adapter = self.adapters["yolo"]
        self.synthetic_generator = SyntheticGenerator(project)
        self.active_learner = ActiveLearner(project, self.active_adapter)

        self.master = tk.Tk()
        self.master.title(f"NeuroLoop (Vision) - {self.project.project_name}")

        self.data_dir = self.project.image_dir_source
        self.supported_extensions = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".bmp", ".webp")
            
        self.data_ids = sorted(
            [
                f
                for f in os.listdir(self.data_dir)
                if f.lower().endswith(self.supported_extensions)
            ]
        )
        self.image_ids = self.data_ids 
        
        # Load session state
        self.index = self.project.session.get("last_image_index", 0)
        self.user_annotations = migrate_annotations(self.project.session.get("annotations", {}))

        # Reinforcement / Correction Tracking
        self.corrections_since_retrain = self.project.session.get("corrections_count", 0)
        self.retrain_buffer = 20  # Can be moved to project config

        self.model_predictions = {}
        
        # UI State
        self.active_tool = "bbox" 
        self.start_x, self.start_y, self.current_shape, self.selected_label = None, None, None, None
        self.current_polygon_points = []
        self.scale = 1.0
        self.orig_img = None
        self.tkimg = None

        self.label_file = os.path.join(self.project.dataset_dir, "labels.json")
        self.label_list, self.label_colors = self.load_label_list()

        self._setup_ui()
        self._setup_menu()
        
        # Apply Theme
        self.theme = ThemeManager.apply_theme(self.master, "dark")
        self.canvas.configure(bg=self.theme["canvas_bg"])
        
        self.master.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.on_closing)

        if self.data_ids:
            self.show_current_data()

    def on_closing(self):
        """Handle window close event."""
        self.save_session()
        self.master.destroy()

    def save_session(self):

    def apply_image_tag(self):
        if not self.selected_label:
            messagebox.showwarning("No Label", "Select a label from the 'Object Labels' list first.")
            return
        
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        self.user_annotations.setdefault(filename, {"objects": [], "image_tags": []})
        
        current_tags = self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"]
        if self.selected_label not in current_tags:
            current_tags.append(self.selected_label)
            self.update_tag_listbox()
            self.update_stats()

    def on_tag_right_click(self, event):
        try:
            selected_index = self.tag_listbox.nearest(event.y)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_clear(0, tk.END)
            self.tag_listbox.selection_set(selected_index)
            selected_tag = self.tag_listbox.get(selected_index)
            
            if messagebox.askyesno("Delete Tag", f"Delete the image tag '{selected_tag}'?"):
                filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
                self.user_annotations[filename]["image_tags"].remove(selected_tag)
                self.update_tag_listbox()
                self.update_stats()
        except tk.TclError:
            # Click was not on an item
            pass
            
    def update_tag_listbox(self):
        self.tag_listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
        filename = self.image_ids[self.index]
        current_tags = self.user_annotations.get(filename, {}).get("image_tags", [])
        for tag in sorted(current_tags):
            self.tag_listbox.insert(tk.END, tag)

        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Suggest Next (Active Learning)", command=self.suggest_next_image).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(5,0))
        tk.Button(btn_frame, text="Save Session", command=self.save_session).pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10,0))


    def suggest_next_image(self):
        # Identify unlabelled files
        all_files = set(self.data_ids)
        labelled_files = set(self.user_annotations.keys())
        unlabelled = list(all_files - labelled_files)
        
        if not unlabelled:
            messagebox.showinfo("Active Learning", "All images are already annotated!")
            return
            
        self.update_stats("Active Learning: Analyzing unlabelled images...")
        self.master.update()
        
        # Sample a subset to keep UI responsive (e.g. 10 random files from unlabelled)
        # In a real app, this would run in background
        subset = random.sample(unlabelled, min(len(unlabelled), 10))
        
        suggestions = self.active_learner.uncertainty_sampling(subset, n_samples=1, strategy="least_confidence")
        
        if suggestions:
            target = suggestions[0]
            if target in self.data_ids:
                idx = self.data_ids.index(target)
                self.index = idx
                self.show_current_data()
                self.update_stats(f"Jumped to suggested image: {target}")
            else:
                self.update_stats("Error finding suggested image.")
        else:
            self.update_stats("Could not determine a suggestion.")
